summary: Pagination with previous and next buttons, page numbers and ellipses, where a pixel block slides to the page you pick.

props.name: total
props.description: Number of pages. Rounded down; a value below 1, or not a number, shows one page.

props.name: page
props.description: Controlled current page, from 1. Rounded and clamped to 1 to `total`. Use with `onPageChange`.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called when the user picks a page. Changing `page` from code does not call it.

accessibility: The root is a `<nav>` with `aria-label="Pagination"` (pass `aria-label` to change it).
Page buttons are native buttons labelled "Page N"; the current one has `aria-current="page"`.
The previous and next buttons are labelled "Previous page" and "Next page" and are disabled at the ends.

Ellipses are `aria-hidden`. After a pick, focus stays on the pressed button, so Next can be pressed repeatedly; when that button becomes disabled (Next on the last page), focus moves to the new current page.
motion: With reduced motion the current-page block jumps instead of sliding.
notes: Up to seven pages are all shown. Beyond that it shows the first and last page, a window around the current page and ellipses.
It does not navigate or load data; handle `onPageChange`.
